limits.scheduling: Owned same-mask contenders exercise bounded CPU pressure. No OS scheduler trace or game workload. Four restricted logical CPUs match a count only, not hosted CPU model, SMT topology or performance.

limits.cpuCounters: Windows counters can be quantized. Signed residuals are retained; wall minus CPU is not OS scheduling time.
limits.jit: A same-implementation authored warm control is an experiment, not proof that a particular miss was JIT compilation.
limits.gc: Main-isolate temporal overlap only; no causal subtraction or worker GC observation.
limits.scheduling: Owned same-mask contenders exercise bounded CPU pressure. No OS scheduler trace or game workload. Four restricted logical CPUs match a count only, not hosted CPU model, SMT topology or performance.
